notes.title: Dice Knight now available!
notes.content:
[b]Dice Knight[/b] is [b]available[/b]! 
Every feedback/review/criticism is welcomed! 
I hope you'll enjoy the game!

notes.title: Knight Dice Demo
notes.content:
Knight Dice participate in Steam Game Festival, so Demo is available during the festival. If you've played the game, please tell your impression, every suggestion/critics are welcome!
The game will be released in the next few week, probably in the second half of October.
